 F1 Brazil Grand Prix: Full race results
 Full results from the race at the 2026 F1 Sao Paulo Grand Prix in Brazil.
 Luke Newman 08 Nov 2026 Share Lewis Hamilton © XPB Images Prefer Crash.Net on Google See our stories more often Add The Brazil Grand Prix saw drama with a different grid order after multiple drivers took grid penalties and ever-changing weather conditions throughout the 71 Lap race.
 However, come the end of the race, it was Lando Norris who took a commanding victory as he crossed the line with a 14.6-second lead over the field.
 Max Verstappen came from 21st on the grid to second place at the chequered flag, as Red Bull completed the podium with Isack Hadjar also featuring in third place.
 Mercedes secured the 2026 Constructors’ Championship as George Russell and Kimi Antonelli finished in fourth and fifth place.
 Outside of the top five was the McLaren of Oscar Piastri in sixth place, with Charles Leclerc in seventh place.
